candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order to return 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side metrics/logs to confirm payment is the slow origin vs. order-side client timeout.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations; traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout and order returning 502, propagating to gateway. Inventory/redis succeed. Payment-side evidence absent, so bounded to downstream latency at payment.
